purpose: Construct verification-side observed means for three non-overlapping future 30-day 2 m temperature windows.
failure_conditions: forecast state lacks a complete daily state date
forecast state site/target/time convention does not match daily Windermere South Basin 2 m temperature
scientific_assumptions: windows are anchored after the last usable daily state date
at least 27 valid daily means are required
target output must not be passed to forecasting components
manifest_status: internal portability aid; not an official LifeWatch manifest
